name: Abutilon

shared_genus_recognition.look_here_first: Inspect the staminal column and count style branches; then inspect the mature segmented fruit and its mericarp tips.
shared_traits: Alternate cordate leaves with stellate hairs
Five-petaled flowers with a staminal column
Dry segmented fruit with multiple mericarps

species_comparison_matrix.fruticosum: compact cask-shaped, no long divergent beaks

species_comparison_matrix.theophrasti: tall annual with large velvety leaves

overlap_cautions: fruticosum and incanum share cordate hairy leaves and compact fruits; use style counts with fruit anatomy.
Corolla color and leaf size vary; do not use alone.
Retain each canonical species native-range label unchanged.

local_lookalikes.separate: Compare mericarp form and style number.
Compare leaves, calyx and fruit segments.
Furled corolla and fleshy fruit differ from dry Abutilon fruit.

diagnostic_photo_checklist: Same-scale flower-center macros for all three; label and count style branches
Mature fruit top and side views with ruler; mark mericarp beaks
Detached mericarp apex of fruticosum versus incanum
Matched mature leaf upper/lower surfaces and basal stems

handoffs.question: Verify additional calyx, mericarp-apex and style-count thresholds from authoritative keys before making a strict dichotomous key.
